scope: Source review, saved49-frame diagnostic review, and independent CPU-only input/affine checks. Reviewer did not run GPU inference or edit root sources.

validation: The first3 categories partition every primitive. Fourth below-minimum category intentionally overlaps and is excluded from partition conservation.
Magenta changes only a temporary rendering colors_precomp clone. The original asset and its saved coefficients remain unchanged.
A@RGB equality proves the exact null-space effect on the27429 BUILD appearance-fit rows. It does not assert unchanged HELD images or every pixel in the larger visible mask.
Reported fractions use sums of alpha*T divided by summed alpha on each fixed image domain. They are contribution-weighted fractions within a frame.
statistical_limits: The macro means above give each camera equal weight. Pixel counts cannot reconstruct an exact pooled alpha-weighted fraction unless each frame alpha denominator is saved.
Points below the minimum of sparse real199 measurements are extrapolation diagnostics. The minimum is not a true underside boundary or a certificate of empty space.

RV.limit: The frame/sample depth consistency is same-source validation, not independent precision ground truth.

checked: R0 andR0_repeat use identical conditioning, original generated initial noise, and restored CPU/CUDA RNG after model construction.
Each arm uses1000 frozen DDPM steps with no clipping/optimizer/post-training change. Conditioning is checked unchanged.
RY applies proper yaw to the entire affine M. It is neither a single-axis reflection nor a translation-preserving partial matrix edit.
RV deterministic BUILD-frame selection and fixed200 without replacement match the stated input.
The latest run saves100-step native-coordinate snapshots, compares R0_repeat trajectories, paired generated-row shifts and symmetric generated-set distances.
Summary does not certify exact replay or adopt an asset.
probe_v3.exact_failure: The parent reported the v2 exact next-step smoke failed and formal sampling was withheld. This review does not reclassify that failure as an affine/input-coordinate error.

backend_evidence.operation: floating-point atomicAdd into voxel feature accumulation
backend_evidence.meaning: Source-supported possible backend non-bitwise numerical variation. Not a proof that this one kernel is the exclusive cause.

precision_gate.description: One next-step at t967 repeated from the same saved state after32 warm steps.
precision_gate.meaning: Preregistered engineering tolerance. It does not establish metre-level shape accuracy or1000-step stability.

conclusion_limits: Use the final full R0_repeat drift, rather than the one-step smoke alone, to contextualize RY/RV differences.
Two same-input full samples provide an observed numerical-drift reference, not a statistical bound or a hypothesis test.
Separate R0-versus-historical-output drift from current R0_repeat-versus-R0 drift; the historical comparison can include environment/software changes.
Paired diffusion row indices are seed slots, not identified physical surface correspondences. Symmetric point-set distances are needed alongside row shifts.
If RY/RV differences are comparable with repeat drift, report unresolved sensitivity.
RV changes view, time, purity and spatial distribution together; no isolated denoising claim.
Sparse partial distance and observed minimum height cannot select the true front convention or establish hidden geometry/RGB accuracy.

findings.title: Avoid a success receipt before the long-run gate
findings.issue: smoke writes PASS_LIMITED_PRECISION_DIAGNOSTIC, then raises if projected four-arm duration exceeds1hour. run checks only the receipt status, so the saved success receipt can bypass the required longer smoke on a subsequent invocation.
findings.recommendation: Compute the long-run decision before success receipt publication. Persist a non-success state when the10-minute smoke is required. Bind accepted smoke to the current contract/model/code hashes.
findings.current_effect: Conditional enforcement gap; actual projected duration was not supplied to this reviewer.

findings.title: Record the proposed mean next-step error
findings.issue: The parent proposed maxerror/meanerror reporting. Current smoke stores only max error for each of8 repeated next-step outputs.
findings.recommendation: Add per-repeat mean absolute error and optionally native-coordinate error while the outputs are already present; retain all exact-failure logs.

findings.title: Retain alpha denominators for pooled statistics
findings.issue: Per-frame contribution fractions are valid but current JSON does not retain their alpha sums.
findings.recommendation: Keep current framewise or explicitly named macro statistics. Save alpha sums/group sums when an exact pooled all49 statistic is wanted.

deferred: No new appearance prior, texture fitting, kernel replacement or model/geometry correction is proposed as part of this I/O attribution probe.
